organs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make ONLY the following corrections to this cute kidney battlefield. Preserve the exact kidney exterior silhouette, notch, orientation, existing triangle/flower-shaped geometric cover islands, spacious floor, framing and current cute pastel cartoon style. 1) The recessed bowl is MUCH TOO DEEP: make it only VERY SLIGHTLY RECESSED like a shallow flat serving tray, matching other organ maps. Reduce visible inner wall HEIGHT and apparent recess depth to about ONE FIFTH of this reference. Remove the several tall stepped cliff bands and thick outer rim. Replace them with ONE SINGLE NARROW SOFT INNER BEVEL around the edge, a thin cream highlight and a very small soft inner shadow. The edge should occupy only about 3% of the organ width, with a broad gently flat pink floor. No deep bowl, no trench, no tall walls, no stepped canyon. Retain just enough subtle inset shading to read as a playable battlefield. 2) DELETE ALL GREEN leaf/plant patches completely, including tiny green remnants behind terrain islands; repair their footprints with warm coral/peach/ivory terrain. No green pixels, no plants/leaves; this is inside the body. Keep simple matte peach/cream decorative kidney terrain chips if needed, not vegetation. Do not add objects or increase obstacle count. No vessels, tubes, insects, worms, pores or wet-looking flesh. Transparent background. This is a small local revision of rim depth and unwanted green accents, not a redesign.
